name: Gold Silver to a new World (Neo Genesis)

releases.name: Gold Silver to a new World (Neo Genesis)

description.text:
The first expansion of the Pokémon Card ★neo series, built on the games Gold and Silver, released in Japan on 4 February 2000 together with the neo Starter Pack; the first Neo Premium File had come out ahead of them, on 10 December 1999. It brought in all the series' new elements at once: Darkness and Metal Pokémon and their Energy, Baby Pokémon, Pokémon Tools, and the legendary Lugia. The card face changed a little, but the cards stayed fully playable with the earlier series.

A few cards, among them Typhlosion, Donphan and Darkness Energy, exist both with a text error and corrected. In English the set became Neo Genesis in December 2000.
